label: Reply to an incoming WhatsApp message
info: Answers a private WhatsApp message that arrives on your number, at most once an hour for each person.

name: START HERE: setup in 3 steps (select this note)
info:
**Setup in 3 steps** (once, about five minutes)

1. **Link your WhatsApp number.** In the [Turbo Notify dashboard](https://dashboard.turbonotify.com) create an account if you have none (it is free), then open **Numbers** and connect your WhatsApp number. First time? Follow the [step by step guide](https://docs.turbonotify.com/en/guides/quickstart/).
2. **Create an API key.** Open **API keys** and create one with the **AI agent (MCP)** template. Copy it, it is shown only once. This flow uses the scopes events:read and messages:send.
3. **Paste it here.** Double-click a whatsapp node of this flow, click the pencil next to **Account**, paste the key and press **Test**. It tells you whether the key works and whether your number is linked.

**About this flow.** The events node checks for new messages every 30 seconds. The first check after you deploy only remembers the newest message, so write to your number from another phone after the deploy and wait up to 30 seconds for the answer. Each person gets one answer per hour (change COOLDOWN_HOURS in the function node), so two auto-responders cannot answer each other forever. Replying automatically sends real messages from your number: answer only people who expect it. Answers leave one every 10 seconds and never more than 60 an hour in all, so a busy day cannot use up your message allowance.
